description: Poliovirus serotype 1 whole-genome multiple sequence alignment, Sabin-anchored
name: PV1_unified

parameter_departures.gap_extend: 0.5 on both --add passes. Upstream never set MAFFT's --ep at all, so gap *extension* sat at the default 0.123 through every build, which is what let a single unalignable fragment open a wide insertion block: opening the gap is paid for once and widening it is nearly free. Measured on POLIO_unified's real pass-1 input, CDS width goes 2465 -> 2300 aa at --ep 0.5 with --op unchanged. Raising --op instead makes it *wider* (2883 aa at 6.0), so the penalty pair is not monotonic in width and --op 4.5 is kept because it measures best.
parameter_departures.pass1_gap_open: 4.5 for every unified artifact. Upstream used 3.0 for polio, which its own source documents as producing a deterministic CDS width blowup with no benefit; 4.5 was applied once as a command-line override and never propagated into the script.
parameter_departures.pass2_local_gap_open: -24.0. Upstream's shipped builds ran at MAFFT's default of -2.00 through every build, which shreds short addon fragments. This is the larger scientific change of the two.
